hook: Cloud-Top Trails, Black Sand and Lava Pools
caption:
One Portuguese island. Six landscapes that hardly look like they belong together. 🌿

📍 Pico do Arieiro — mountain paths weave high above the clouds.
📍 Fanal Forest — twisted ancient laurel trees disappear into the mist.
📍 Seixal — black sand sits beneath the lush north-coast cliffs.
📍 Risco Waterfall — water drops into deep green forest.
📍 Porto Moniz — swim in natural pools bordered by volcanic rock.
📍 Ponta de São Lourenço — follow a sunrise trail on Madeira's wild eastern headland.

Which scene would you go to first?

Photos: Samielle Støyl, Colin Watts, Julia Schuwer, Daniel J. Schwarz & Mick Kirchman / Unsplash.

#YourTravelAtlas #Madeira #PortugalTravel #IslandEscapes #TravelReels
editorial_intent: Show six real visually contrasting Madeira scenes in a silent mobile-first editorial photo-slideshow Reel, not a genuine footage Reel.
share_reason: The unexpected contrast between cloud-top ridges, eerie laurel forest, black sand, dramatic waterfall, lava pools and sunrise peninsula makes a memorable Portuguese-island saveable discovery.
